scientific_integrity: Polynomial identities are justified by a proven cubic-degree bound and exact four-point evaluations; exhaustive finite permutation checks supplement rather than replace the analytic proof. Related known length-two and descent-set results are attributed, not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Exact first covariance only; all pattern lengths are covered by the boundary identity, but the complete sign classification is restricted to lengths at most four. No independent priority or scientific validation is claimed. Older generalized joint generating functions could implicitly encode a special case.
title: The first covariance-sign reversals for fixed points and consecutive patterns
